findings.title: RERA Registration & Promoter Check
findings.headline: RERA registration matches Surya Humming Bird, but promoter names show differences
findings.explanation: The project name Surya Humming Bird matches RERA registration number PRM/KA/RERA/1251/446/PR/210928/004305 [E1, E7, E8]. The listing names the builder as Surya [E2], whereas the official RERA filing lists H Ramachandra as the promoter [E9]. A RERA registration record does not prove land ownership or clear property title.

summary: The Surya Humming Bird project is registered with Karnataka RERA with a proposed completion date of December 31, 2025 [E7, E8, E10]. While the project name and location correspond across records, promoter names differ between the listing and RERA [E2, E9], and pricing could not be verified [E4]. Buyers should remember that a RERA record does not prove ownership or clear title to the property.
buyer_checklist: Verify the title search report and title deed to ensure the seller has clear ownership.
Confirm that the promoter name H Ramachandra is authorized to execute sales for Surya Humming Bird.
Review the sanctioned building plans and Commencement Certificate (CC) issued by the local authority.
Check that the possession date in the agreement matches the RERA deadline of December 31, 2025.
Request an itemized price breakdown including base rate, clubhouse fees, car parking, and taxes.
Confirm the specific unit's RERA-defined carpet area before paying any funds.
Verify that the bank account used for payments is the designated RERA project escrow account.
Ensure there are no undisclosed bank mortgages or encumbrances on the project land.
limitations_text: This report compares information published on a listing, a builder website and a RERA portal at the time shown. A successful RERA search does not prove that every detail is true, that the individual seller owns the flat, or that the property is free of legal issues. Not verified does not mean something is wrong, only that we could not confirm it. Before paying any amount, consider independent legal verification of title, approvals and encumbrances. This is an information aid, not legal advice or a guarantee.
